knowledgePoint.title: Evaluating a Logarithm With a Calculator Using the Change of Base Formula

solution:
Let's calculate $\log_{17}(17)$ by changing the base $17$ to the common logarithm (base $10$).

We use the change of base formula:

$$
\log_a X=\frac{\log_b X}{\log_b a}
$$

In our case, $a=17,$ $X=17,$ $b=10.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\log_{17}(17) & =\frac{\log_{10}(17)}{\log_{10}(17)} \\ & =\frac{\log(17)}{\log(17)} \\ & \approx \frac{1.230449}{1.230449} \\ & \approx 1.000\end{aligned}
$$
title: Evaluating a Logarithm With a Calculator Using the Change of Base Formula
